scenicChapters.title: Coldfoot → Atigun Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 223 km. 1444 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Atigun Pass → Deadhorse
scenicChapters.narrative: 510 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it. This is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.

dalton-highway.story: 1432 km from Fairbanks to Prudhoe Bay, about 19 h 24 of riding. The stops in between: Yukon River Crossing, Arctic Circle, Coldfoot and Atigun Pass. The highest point is about 1,450 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
